data.not_claimed: that the framework or convention D is wrong, or that no closure exists; only that none is findable by any enumeration this corpus has run
data.verdict: SCOPE-(a) TERMINUS. With the two-row cap DERIVED (2-dim mass fibre; FibreDimensionForcesTL, bean qou-n1dj), z = z_D is forced and the block-weight leg has NO remaining freedom -- g = 0.5054042265 against a required 0.8891258104. The other two legs are measured-negative: the character ratio an element would need, 1.5516573513, matches no declared form (nearest [3]_q/[2]_q at 2.45 %, next 3/2 at 3.33 % -- basket distance, not isolation), and the trace->MeV scale was enumerated on 2026-08-29 with nothing within 6.31 %. So no parameter-free closure of the convention-D Q_beta exists in any of the three legs, joining the four correction classes already closed. NOT a proved impossibility: this is an enumeration over declared classes, and a DERIVED (not searched) decay element with the right character ratio would still close it. Searching for such an element on the number would be a fit, so the ratio is recorded as a target to check a future derivation against, never as a search criterion.
data.scope: (a) enumeration over declared classes, NOT a proved impossibility
